_comment: Steam settings (issue #150, docs/STEAM.md). app_id stays 0 until the Steamworks app exists: with 0 the game never starts Steam, even in a build that has GodotSteam (unless Steam itself launched it, which sets SteamAppId). 'presence' is the Rich Presence text Steam shows friends: tools/steam_files.gd writes it to steam/rich_presence_english.vdf, which is uploaded in Steamworks (Community > Rich Presence). Every chapter in data/journal.json needs a 'chapters' entry (tests check). Keys in braces are filled in by the game.
